reason: Telemetry prerequisites not met; running attack would produce no detectable evidence

elasticsearch_cron_docs.check: ES query for cron/crontab in message field

blocker_summary: T1053.003 cannot be tested because: (1) cron daemon is not running in the target container, (2) rsyslog cron logging is disabled, (3) no cron.log file exists, (4) zero cron-related documents are indexed in Elasticsearch. The attack would successfully modify /etc/crontab but generate no log entries for detection.
remediation_options: Start cron daemon in target container: service cron start
Enable cron logging in rsyslog: uncomment 'cron.*' line in /etc/rsyslog.d/50-default.conf
Or: Use VM-based environment where cron logging is enabled by default
